items.docs:
Retrieve the mail configuration for your SendGrid account.

A valid environment token is required to call this endpoint. You can obtain it from the environment authentication route.

Configure your SendGrid account to send emails from your environment.

Provide your SendGrid secret key in the request body.

A valid environment token is required to call this endpoint. You can obtain it from the environment authentication route.

Delete the mail configuration for your SendGrid account.

A valid environment token is required to call this endpoint. You can obtain it from the environment authentication route.

Configure email settings for your environment, supporting SES, Mailgun, and SendGrid.

Provide the email provider, sender details, and any additional parameters in the request body.

A valid environment token is required to call this endpoint. You can obtain it from the environment authentication route.
